biocs.name: Uncommon Network Connection Under Untrusted Causality Actor
biocs.description: Detects a process that initiates a network connection under an untrusted causality actor.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name not in ('/usr/bin/bash', '/bin/sh', '/usr/sbin/sshd')
| filter action_remote_ip in ('192.0.2.1', '192.0.2.2', '192.0.2.3')
| filter action_process_image_name like '/tmp/%'

abiocs.name: Uncommon Network Connection from Untrusted Causality Actor
